column3: Uniform additive constant for all k,n requires switch-graph control related to semidegree cycle thresholds. No finite isolated matching would establish the uniform claim without definitions and a scalable obstruction; no such mechanism found.

Each of n graphs meets Ore's degree-sum condition, but separate Hamilton cycles do not supply distinct edge colors. A color-exchange absorption argument for arbitrary families remains missing; identical-graph cases give no full result.

Primary Conjecture1.2 and Theorem1.3 match all fixed ell>=3 for sufficiently large n; ell=2 is explicitly credited to Liu–Zeng. No new outcome. Selected theorem passage read, not the complete proof or cited ell=2 body.

Double-exponential growth requires a scalable 4-uniform construction for every n>=5 with an absolute exponent; finite Ramsey instances cannot certify it. The source title suggests progress but was not treated as proof-body evidence.

Even-genus qualification and purely-non-free action definitions require primary comparison. Finiteness for each fixed signature n does not imply finiteness over all signatures; no uniform signature bound found. Odd-genus wording changes earn no credit.

Universal sharp spectral inequality on all triangles needs analytic control over degenerating shapes and uniqueness. An equilateral evaluation only checks normalization and cannot settle shape minimization.
Need a first-player strategy with dimension C_q q^n simultaneously for every n at each prime power. A strategy for q=2 or a finite board is insufficient; no uniform strategy found.
Arbitrary H and all m>=chi(H)|H| require general Ramsey goodness. Bipartite or complete target cases do not resolve it; no full extremal mechanism found.
For each bounded degree, must rule out every infinite strong-immersion antichain of Eulerian digraphs. Finite tests cannot certify well-quasi-ordering and no structural reduction available.

X_n is universal over Hadamard actions on all H_m and Y_n is only source-defined. Need literal Y_n inequalities before searching degree5 counterexamples; low-degree equalities are given and uncredited.
Exact discrete asymptotic needs both construction and upper bound at a cubic irrational constant. Odd-fat relaxation certificate alone cannot prove integrality or asymptotic attainability.
Every induced subgraph must admit a three-part maximum-clique-avoiding partition. A coloring of the input alone is not this hereditary property; no uniform even-hole-free decomposition found.
Arbitrary k-lists with k>Delta and global color quotas require simultaneous equitable allocation. Ordinary Hajnal–Szemeredi or ordinary list colorability does not bridge these constraints.

Literal statement loses TeX commands and does not specify the variables of the polynomial bound. The metadata's refuted label conflicts with prose and supplies no witness. Exact NTP2/conjunction definitions and primary counterexample body needed.
Must obtain a finite additive basis of reversed primes in every base. Ordinary prime additive-basis theorems do not preserve reversed digits; no density/transference route justified.
Uniform O(log b) bound is stronger than existence for each base; known lower bounds along a sequence do not give an upper bound. No constructive reversed-prime decomposition found.
Arbitrary tree and every connectivity k with exact degree threshold require preserving all k-separators after deletion. Paths or k<=3 are already credited source cases, not full-scope progress.
Polynomial's unique positive root is elementary but identifying the random K_r-factor Hamiltonicity threshold for every r is the substantive gap. A root computation would only be a helper.

F, permutation domain X, allowed q,n and reflection are not defined literally beyond source references. Cannot run a meaningful permutation minimization or claim counterexample before recovering the model.
For each fixed k>=6 need improve the exponent from ceil(k/2) to ceil(k/3) uniformly over all point sets with no (k+1)-hole. Checking Horton configurations would only examine a construction subclass.

Need positive logarithmic lower and finite logarithmic upper constants for each fixed density. Corrupted literal TeX does not supply a finite exact extremal route; finite sumset searches cannot prove both limiting bounds.
All s<a<=b and sufficiently large t require matching n^s generalized Turan bounds. s=2,3 are source-known; no uniform higher-s construction/counting argument found.

Primary Theorem1.8 explicitly asserts full Nash–Williams conjecture; Section12.2 assembly proof read against delta>=3n/4 and K3-divisibility. Theorems12.4–12.8 and their substantial dependencies were not audited. Public full-scope theorem defeats a discovery proposal here.

High-girth decompositions at exact 3n/4 remain stronger than source's stated asymptotic corollary with epsilon slack. Literal girth wording includes trivial configurations unless conventional exclusions supplied; no credit for this wording issue.

Full edge decomposition into any n-vertex 2-factor at (3/4+epsilon)n is stronger than packing (1-o(1))e(G) edges. Source application discussion does not close the leftover absorption gap; no proof claimed.

Unbalanced means the source's measurable expansion condition, not merely unequal finite sides. Konig's finite theorem does not provide a measurable Delta-edge-coloring for every probability measure; primary definitions needed.

Nonadjacent maximum-degree vertices give a finite edge-coloring intuition but arbitrary Borel graph and every measure require measurable choices. No measurable matching iteration with preserved hypotheses justified.
Ku Conjecture5.1 overlaps held Ku family in bound ledger; its equivalent Conjecture5.3 has prior Johnson1981 exclusion. Selected source passage confirms scope. No repeat sweep or new family proposal.
Ku Conjecture5.2 is same held torus family; narrow k6 Conjecture5.4 route already held and generic lower bounds excluded. Preserve prior objections; no reopening or alternate-witness credit.

Universal all k,d equality needs source's precise configuration definition and known even/coprime construction restrictions. Primary Conjecture5.6 matches these quantifiers and source proves d=2; no all-d mechanism found.
Uniform displacement function for every n-generated ideal and arbitrary symmetric rank requires group-ring homological control. Rank1 freeness does not produce length r-1 resolutions for higher rank.

Compositionality and associated Y need source rank-condition definitions for arbitrary flag type; two-step calculations do not control all compositions. No small exact algebraic certificate available from literal record.

Asymptotically sharp independence bound for all linear k-uniform hypergraphs and all sufficiently large Delta needs an optimal constant. High-girth sampling loses the desired constant; no repair found.

Primary Conjecture5.2 matches every finite complex and k>=1. Theorem4.2 body gives only mu+(n-mu)/(k+2); missing-face overcounting loses the required factor. No small counterexample or sharp inequality found, so no spectral formal chain investment.

Primary Props3.1–3.2 give clique threshold and extension after deleting dominated independent vertices. For fixed k retain maximal neighborhood types, at most binom(k,floor(k/2)), brute-force the constant kernel, extend a coloring or return the uncolorable kernel as certificate. Linear preprocessing via at most 2^k masks gives full scope, but is a short direct adaptation of source lemmas; no discovery proposal.

All reciprocal odd angles and every dimension require an exact equiangular-line bound. Known non-odd reciprocal counterexamples do not touch this restricted domain; no suitable Gram/Seidel witness found.
Every graph with Delta>=9 and forbidden Delta-clique must be (Delta-1)-choosable for arbitrary lists. Claw-free and large-Delta cases do not cover all graphs in the remaining degree band.
Requires line-free colorings in every dimension at bracket level HJ(t,r)-1 for every t,r>=2. Known HJ numbers or finite colorings do not yield a uniform hierarchy-collapse construction.

Record's computational explanation says equality exactly at odd prime powers while its last clause says strict inequality there; source comparison needed. Quantified non-prime-power claim is not refuted by this prose inconsistency. No reciprocal-Rado coloring certificate constructed.

Need exact stiffness-matrix normalization, collisions and second-largest eigenvalue counting convention. Coplanar images and repeated points may alter multiplicity but cannot be used before the source definitions; no eigenvalue claim made.
For every k needs some minimum-outdegree threshold forcing disjoint directed cycles with all distinct lengths. k1 or ordinary cycle packing cannot bridge simultaneous length distinctions.

Record's solved label is not proof evidence. All sufficiently large dimensions require a unit-distance digraph construction with exponential convergence, not merely arbitrary dense digraphs; primary body unread.

For each fixed planar H and k need polynomial-time MIS on graphs forbidding anticomplete minor models. Quasi-polynomial recursion and easy H cases do not establish a polynomial exponent uniformly over input size.

Primary v1 Definition1.2 recovered exact half-up rounded steering letters; bound text search did not locate the stated exact exponential formula in this fetched body. Exact 2000-term counts match k<=3 but miss one k4 factor; finite absence is no refutation. All-length factor realization remains unsupported; source/version qualification HOLD.

Every n>=k+1 with exact degree threshold is stronger than sufficiently-large-n Hamilton-power theorems. Small exceptions or cycle-convention corrections would not count; no general constructive route found.

Uniform sublinear beta means supremum over graph sequences; i=o(n) trivial case does not address i linear in n. Metadata refuted label supplies no counterexample. Need source body and an explicit family with both hitting and independent-domination parameters large.
Threshold T_j and distinct-dimensions conventions are source-defined. m4,5,6 already known; full m>=7 wall-minimizing tilings need matching construction and lower bound across every middle regime.

Joint Dickman distribution for consecutive integers at all a,b is substantive independence, not marginal smooth-number asymptotics. a=0 convention is a wording issue only; no all-parameter analytic route.

Every fixed k and every ordering need density 1/k! among consecutive largest prime factors. Symmetry heuristics and k2 estimates do not imply full joint independence; no tractable full-scope mechanism.

Primary Conjecture7.1 exact all n,D recovered; Proposition7.2 and Lemma7.3 reduce to fixed-ground-set high-intersection multisets. 3003 exact unbalanced-simplex comparisons found no improvement, but do not examine arbitrary anticodes. Dimension3 slab/K4 proof does not extend automatically; general structural bound missing.
